Jasmine / team,

Thanks for the ping. I reviewed the redline and the phrase we originally proposed around aggregated telemetry remains appropriate, but we should tighten it slightly to avoid ambiguity. Suggested language: 

"Neither party will disclose Customer-specific confidential information. Notwithstanding the foregoing, either party may publicly disclose aggregated, de-identified metrics and performance data that do not identify the other party or its customers, provided such disclosure does not disclose or imply non-public benchmarks or internal performance thresholds of the other party."

Rationale: this allows us to keep the common "aggregated metrics" carveout while preventing the risk Skybridge flagged about revealing internal benchmarks. Its short and should be acceptable to both sides.

Also attached: Redwood_Skybridge_MSA_Redlines.docx with inline suggestion above.
